import json,glob,copy,datetime as dt,holidays,calendar,os
LANDS=['BW','BY','BE','BB','HB','HH','HE','MV','NI','NW','RP','SL','SN','ST','SH','TH']
HC={}
def hol(land,y):
    k=(land,y)
    if k not in HC: HC[k]=holidays.Germany(subdiv=land,years=y) if land else holidays.Germany(years=y)
    return HC[k]
def work(d,land): return d.weekday()<5 and d not in hol(land,d.year)
def addm(d,n):
    y,m=divmod(d.month-1+n,12); y+=d.year; m+=1
    return dt.date(y,m,min(d.day,calendar.monthrange(y,m)[1]))
def fwd(d,n,u,land):
    if u=='days': return d+dt.timedelta(n)
    if u=='weeks': return d+dt.timedelta(7*n)
    if u=='months': return addm(d,n)

    d=dt.date.fromisoformat(frm)

def remedy(key,posted,law,land,fic_cite=None,rem=None,rem_cite=None,why_pre='',stated=False):
    if law in LAWS: fc,rem0,rc=LAWS[law]
    else: fc,rem0,rc=fic_cite,rem,rem_cite
    rem=rem or rem0; rc=rem_cite or rc
    ao=(law=='AO')
    p=dt.date.fromisoformat(posted); f4=p+dt.timedelta(4)
    steps=[]
    steps.append(f"c02: {'the letter states its posting day' if stated else 'the letter states no separate posting day, so its date is the posting day'}: {h(posted)}.")
    s2=f"c03: deemed notified on the fourth day after posting ({fc}): {h(f4.isoformat())}"
    fsteps=[S('forward',4,'days',ao),S('forward',1,'months',True)]
    nd=run(posted,fsteps[:1],land)
    if f4.isoformat()!=nd: s2+=f"; under c03 the AO moves a fiction day on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday to the next working day: {h(nd)}."
    elif not work(f4,land): s2+="; under c03 the VwVfG and SGB X do not move a fiction day off a weekend or holiday, so it stays."
    else: s2+=", a working day."
    steps.append(s2)
    raw=addm(dt.date.fromisoformat(nd),1).isoformat(); end=run(posted,fsteps,land)
    s3=f"c03: one-month {rem} period ({rc}; §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB): {h(raw)}"
    s3+= "." if raw==end else f", moved off the weekend or holiday to {h(end)}."
    if end[5:] in ('12-24','12-31'): s3+=" f02: 24 and 31 December are working days, so it stays."
    elif raw==end: s3+=" A working day in every Land; nothing moves."
    steps.append(s3)
    fact={'land':land,'from':posted,'event':('posting day stated in the letter' if stated else 'letter date taken as posting day (c02)'),'steps':fsteps}
    why=(why_pre+' ' if why_pre else '')+f"Under c02 the posting day is {h(posted)}; under c03 the {law if law in LAWS else 'Land procedure act'} fiction gives notification on {h(nd)} and the one-month {rem} period ends {h(end)}."
    CH[key]=dict(status='dated',date=end,steps=steps,why=why.strip(),fact=fact)
